basics.name: Himanshu Raj Aman
basics.headline: Backend engineer building reliable systems at national scale.
basics.label: Senior Backend Engineer
basics.summary: Senior Backend Engineer with 4+ years building national-scale academic governance systems in PHP and Yii2, serving 2,000+ institutions and 100,000+ concurrent users. I focus on configurable rule engines, staged processing pipelines, and large-batch performance work — recently cutting a core batch process from 10 hours to under 20 minutes. Open to relocation (Germany / EU).

items.org: Samarth eGov (Ministry of Education, Govt. of India initiative)
highlights: Cut grace-marks batch runtime from 10 hours to under 20 minutes by moving to array-based processing, bulk CASE/WHEN SQL updates, keyset pagination, and MySQL JSON aggregation.

Rebuilt result processing as a staged pipeline where each stage receives a shared context object and owns one concern — course-count validation, component evaluation, final-result verification, then persistence — with the stages covered by unit tests.

Modelled component pass/fail across combined filters (aggregate vs component-level, required-to-pass, attendance, disciplinary flags), with a simulation mode for dry-run verification before publishing.

Designed a configurable, block-based grace-marks rule engine using JSONLogic conditions and DMN-style hit policies, replacing hardcoded per-ordinance logic with composable rules; modelled pipeline limits at 5,000,000-student scale.
Eliminated recurring lock-wait timeouts by splitting one long transaction into per-batch transactions with exponential-backoff retry and idempotency flags.
Built Flux, an in-house PHP/SSE library streaming long-running job output to the browser through a detached-worker architecture, bypassing Apache's 60-second request timeout.
Led a small backend team through an ERP module overhaul, adding multi-tenancy and code-review standards; held 99.9% uptime across seasonal traffic spikes using AWS ELB, MySQL indexing, and Redis.
Built the UG/PG admissions backend for Delhi University, handling 100,000+ requests during peak submission windows.
Designed a standardised marks-entry data model adopted by 2,000+ colleges across multiple Indian states.
Built a priority-based job queue for result processing with per-job status tracking and audit logging; diagnosed priority starvation that left large batches indefinitely deferred.
Built parallel PDF report generation with chunked pipelines that preserve sort order; fixed mPDF backtrack-limit failures through incremental rendering.
Exposed UIMS services to AI tooling through MCP servers in PHP, built on a reflection-based method index.
Integrated the National Academic Depository (NAD) API for secure academic record uploads and built template parsers for document automation.
Built student feedback systems with automated Excel reporting using PHP Spreadsheet.
